about: Model A input (DATA-CONTRACT 7.1): channel order and units. The Flutter app (mobile/lib/device/model_channels.dart) and the training scripts both read this order; a Dart test keeps them identical. Units decided 2026-10-22 (docs/SESSIONS.md S4C): FSR kPa, accel g, gyro deg/s.

pairing.about: How the two feet's samples form one 24-channel row (mobile/lib/device/model_channels.dart pairFeet; tools/capture/load_capture.py). The feet have separate clocks and sample instants, so rows are paired by unix time.
pairing.rule: Each left sample (ascending unix_ms) takes the right sample nearest in unix_ms within +-toleranceMs inclusive, ties to the earlier one; each right sample is used at most once, in order; a left sample with none in reach gives no row.
